This is an application for quashing of the order dated 24.01.2014 passed in Complaint Case No. 574 of 2013, Tr. No. 2155/2015 passed by the learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Jehanabad whereunder and whereby the cognizance was taken against the accused persons for the alleged offences under Sections 498A, 494 of the Indian Penal Code and sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
Issue notice to Opposite Party No. 2 through both Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.56318 of 2015(2)
dt.23-03-2023 processes i.e. ordinary as well as Registered Cover with A/D for which requisites etc.
must be filed within two weeks failing which this application shall stand dismissed without further Anil Das And Ors. vs State Of Bihar And Anr on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18402193/
1 reference to the bench.
In the meantime, learned counsel for the petitioners will be filing a supplementary affidavit bringing on record the present status of the case.
List this case after appearance of Opposite Party No. 2 and/or Service Report, whichever is earlier.
